name: SG/Vault
description: Zero-knowledge encrypted vault — SgToolApi v0.1.0 layer

events.name: tool:ready
events.detail: { instanceId: string, tool: 'vault', version: { api, ui, content } }

events.name: tool:state-changed
events.when: vault opened, locked, or navigation completes

events.name: vault:opened
events.when: vault token decrypted and file browser mounted
events.detail: { instanceId: string, vaultName: string, vaultId: string | null }

getState.returns: { vaultId: string|null, title: string|null, decrypted: boolean, syncState: { ahead, behind, diverged }, activeView: string, openTabs: string[] }

navigateTo.throws: Error if tab missing or render timeout

getSkills.returns: { human: string, browser: string, api: string }
